name: North Fork

known.article: North Fork of Long Island AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "North Fork of Long Island AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Long Island AVA on the North Fork peninsula, with a maritime climate moderated by Long Island Sound and Peconic Bay.
